title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 40
description: Ten questions on Psalms 40: lifted out of the miry clay, a new song, and delight in doing God's will.

questions.text: How did the psalmist wait for Yahweh in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry."

questions.text: Where did Yahweh set the psalmist's feet after bringing him out of the pit?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says he brought him out of the miry clay and set his feet on a rock.

questions.text: What has Yahweh put in the psalmist's mouth in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says, "He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God."

questions.text: What does verse 6 say Yahweh has opened?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, "Sacrifice and offering you didn't desire. You have opened my ears."

questions.text: Where is it written about the speaker, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says, "It is written about me in the book in the scroll."

answers.text: In the book in the scroll

questions.text: According to verse 8, where is God's law?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says, "Yes, your law is within my heart."

answers.text: On the doorposts of his house

questions.text: In verse 12, the psalmist's iniquities are more than what?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says his iniquities are more than the hairs of his head.

questions.text: What do those who are to be desolate by reason of their shame say to the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says they tell him, "Aha! Aha!"

questions.text: What should those who love God's salvation say continually, according to verse 16?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says, "Let such as love your salvation say continually, 'Let Yahweh be exalted!'"

questions.text: How does the psalmist describe himself in the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says, "But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me."
